A '''Class M''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with an [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]/[[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].

==Behind the scenes==
This is a parallel to the [[Memoryalpha:Class M|Class M planet]] designation from [[Memoryalpha:Star Trek|''Star Trek'']].
